title: Case ownership assigned
requirement: Every incident case must record a named owner accountable for the investigation.
evidence_expectation: An owner field naming a person or team on the case record.

title: Triage severity recorded
requirement: A severity must be recorded on the case at triage.

title: Containment executed for confirmed malware
requirement: When a case involves confirmed malware or C2 activity, a containment action (host isolation, account disable, or network block) must be executed, and the record must show the action was carried out rather than only proposed or approved.
applies_when: The case involves confirmed malware or command-and-control activity.
evidence_expectation: An action, timeline, or artifact entry showing the containment action was performed, with an actor and a timestamp.
exceptions: Containment may be deferred for a business-critical host when the deferral is approved in writing by the IR Manager and recorded on the case.

title: Observables reviewed against threat intelligence
requirement: Every network observable on the case must be reviewed against threat intelligence, and the review outcome recorded on the case.
evidence_expectation: A recorded intelligence review outcome per observable, in a note, comment, or artifact field.

title: Closure rationale recorded
requirement: A closed case must record the rationale for its final disposition.
applies_when: The case status is closed or resolved.
evidence_expectation: A closure note or comment stating why the case was dispositioned as it was.

title: Case sensitivity classification recorded
requirement: Every case must carry a sensitivity classification governing how its contents may be shared.
evidence_expectation: A sensitivity or classification field on the case record.
